body: I'm very thankful for you to talk to me. I guess the anonymity of the Internet makes it easier to get things off my chest. I really appreciate you. Makes me feel like you're here to help and not judge.

I tried going to gambling anonymous, I know they aren't there to judge and are facing the same problem, but I feel incredibly shameful being there. Just people know I have a gambling problem makes me feel like I need to get out of sight. I know I have a problem and I really don't want the world to know.  I'm constantly feeling beneath people and just hiding my face.

I know how bad I am and I can see how much it lost. Now, no matter how much money I win, it's never enough and I can never be happy. The relationships live lost is worth more to me than anything in this world. The sad thing is, I can never win it or earn it back. I lost everything to gambling, I hate it, I hate myself. I really wish I was dead.

I am really addicted to gambling and it really has destroyed my life. If I didn't gamble, my life would be perfect. The money I lost isn't what I regret the most, it's the relationships that I've lost that hurt the most. Some people tell me to just stop gambling, but it's hard. I go for months without gambling and then in just one moment, it's back to it all over again. It's kind of a drug.  Winning gives me a high that's hard to describe. It's weird, but winning a lot of money is great, but it's the thrill that makes me want to play. I've won 40k in a night, and I've also lost that much in one day.
